weaknesses: The abstract inaccurately describes the contributions of the paper, focusing on CRISPR-Cas9 rather than the main topic of catapult dynamics in neural networks.
The claims regarding the novelty of quadratic models in understanding neural network dynamics are overstated, as similar concepts have been explored in prior works.
The paper does not sufficiently address the limitations of quadratic models compared to other existing frameworks, which may mislead readers about their applicability.
The experimental results lack a comprehensive comparison with baseline models, making it difficult to assess the true performance gains of the proposed methods.
strengths: The paper presents a novel perspective on the training dynamics of neural networks using quadratic models, which is a fresh approach in the field.
The theoretical analysis of catapult dynamics is well-articulated and provides valuable insights into the behavior of neural networks under large learning rates.
Empirical results support the theoretical findings, demonstrating the effectiveness of quadratic models in capturing non-linear dynamics.
